import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

namespace D1Bound5

/-- An actual square root of cd+1 has the relative terminal norm bounds
needed for closed forbidden intervals once |cd|≥4000. -/
theorem finite_tuple_root_relative_norm
    (c d z : ℂ) (hz : z^2 = c*d+1) (hCD : 4000 ≤ ‖c‖*‖d‖) :
    (1-1/4000 : ℝ)*‖c‖*‖d‖ ≤ ‖z‖^2 ∧
      ‖z‖^2 ≤ (1+1/4000 : ℝ)*‖c‖*‖d‖ := by
  have hsquare : ‖z‖^2 = ‖c*d+1‖ := by rw [← norm_pow, hz]
  have hhi := norm_add_le (c*d) (1 : ℂ)
  have hlo := norm_sub_le (c*d+1) (1 : ℂ)
  simp only [norm_mul, norm_one] at hhi
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, norm_mul, norm_one] at hlo
  have herr : 1 ≤ (1/4000 : ℝ)*‖c‖*‖d‖ := by nlinarith only [hCD]
  constructor <;> rw [hsquare] <;> nlinarith only [hhi, hlo, herr]

/-- Both endpoints are excluded: each summand is at most one half inside
the closed window, contradicting the strict inequality from an actual
nonzero integral form. -/
theorem finite_closed_window_incompatible
    (C D Z U V eps : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hV : 0 < V) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (heps1 : eps < 1)
    (hrootlo : (1-eps)*C*D ≤ Z^2) (hroothi : Z^2 ≤ (1+eps)*C*D)
    (hform : 1 < U/Z+V*Z)
    (hlower : 4*U^2/(C*(1-eps)) ≤ D)
    (hupper : D ≤ 1/(4*V^2*C*(1+eps))) : False := by
  have heminus : 0 < 1-eps := sub_pos.mpr heps1
  have heplus : 0 < 1+eps := by linarith
  have hlo := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hC heminus)).1 hlower
  have hsquare : (2*U)^2 ≤ Z^2 := by nlinarith only [hlo, hrootlo]
  have hlinear : 2*U ≤ Z := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : Z < 2*U := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hh) (by positivity : 0 < 2*U+Z)
    nlinarith only [hp, hsquare]
  have hfirst : U/Z ≤ (1/2 : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hZ).2
    linarith only [hlinear]
  have hhi := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4*V^2*C*(1+eps))).1 hupper
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroothi (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*V^2)
  have hsq : (2*V*Z)^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith only [hhi, hscaled]
  have hsecond : V*Z ≤ (1/2 : ℝ) := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ 2*V*Z := by positivity
    nlinarith only [hsq, hp, sq_nonneg (2*V*Z-1)]
  linarith only [hform, hfirst, hsecond]

end D1Bound5
sources.FrontierScalarReduction.lean:
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.GCongr
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

namespace D1Bound5

noncomputable def frontierK (alpha beta : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1/2+1/(7*alpha*beta))^2*(1/2+1/(7*beta^2))
noncomputable def frontierL (alpha beta : ℝ) : ℝ := 6*frontierK alpha beta-1/2
noncomputable def frontierQ (alpha beta : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  9*(1/2+1/(7*alpha*beta))^2*(1/2+1/(7*beta^2))^2
noncomputable def frontierP (alpha beta : ℝ) : ℝ := 2/(alpha*beta)+1/beta^2
noncomputable def frontierJ (alpha beta : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2*frontierK alpha beta*(2/(alpha^2*beta^2)+1/beta^4)+
  frontierL alpha beta*(1/(alpha^2*beta^2)+2/(alpha*beta^3))+
  frontierQ alpha beta/(alpha^2*beta^4)

/-- Division-free form of the manuscript normalization: after setting
τ=T/(ABS), the determinant bound becomes τ≤2Kτ²+LPτ+J. -/
theorem frontier_scalar_reduction (A B C T alpha beta K L Q : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < alpha) (hb : 0 < beta)
    (hA : alpha ≤ A) (hB : beta ≤ B) (hC : beta ≤ C) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hupper : A*B*C*T ≤
      2*K*(A^2+B^2+C^2+T^2)+L*(A*B+A*C+A*T+B*C+B*T+C*T)+Q) :
    let tau := T/(A*B*C)
    tau ≤ 2*K*tau^2+L*(2/(alpha*beta)+1/beta^2)*tau+
      (2*K*(2/(alpha^2*beta^2)+1/beta^4)+
       L*(1/(alpha^2*beta^2)+2/(alpha*beta^3))+Q/(alpha^2*beta^4)) := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := ha.trans_le hA
  have hB0 : 0 < B := hb.trans_le hB
  have hC0 : 0 < C := hb.trans_le hC
  have hAn : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA0
  have hBn : B ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB0
  have hCn : C ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hC0
  let tau := T/(A*B*C)
  have htau : 0 ≤ tau := div_nonneg hT (by positivity)
  have hdiag : 1/(B^2*C^2)+1/(A^2*C^2)+1/(A^2*B^2) ≤
      1/beta^4+1/(alpha^2*beta^2)+1/(alpha^2*beta^2) := by
    have h1 : 1/(B^2*C^2) ≤ 1/(beta^2*beta^2) := by gcongr
    have h2 : 1/(A^2*C^2) ≤ 1/(alpha^2*beta^2) := by gcongr
    have h3 : 1/(A^2*B^2) ≤ 1/(alpha^2*beta^2) := by gcongr
    have heq : beta^2*beta^2 = beta^4 := by ring
    rw [heq] at h1
    linarith only [h1,h2,h3]
  have hcross : 1/(B*C)+1/(A*C)+1/(A*B) ≤
      1/beta^2+1/(alpha*beta)+1/(alpha*beta) := by
    have h1 : 1/(B*C) ≤ 1/(beta*beta) := by gcongr
    have h2 : 1/(A*C) ≤ 1/(alpha*beta) := by gcongr
    have h3 : 1/(A*B) ≤ 1/(alpha*beta) := by gcongr
    rw [← pow_two] at h1
    linarith only [h1,h2,h3]
  have hpair : 1/(A*B*C^2)+1/(A*B^2*C)+1/(A^2*B*C) ≤
      1/(alpha*beta^3)+1/(alpha*beta^3)+1/(alpha^2*beta^2) := by
    have h1 : 1/(A*B*C^2) ≤ 1/(alpha*beta*beta^2) := by gcongr
    have h2 : 1/(A*B^2*C) ≤ 1/(alpha*beta^2*beta) := by gcongr
    have h3 : 1/(A^2*B*C) ≤ 1/(alpha^2*beta*beta) := by gcongr
    have heq1 : alpha*beta*beta^2 = alpha*beta^3 := by ring
    have heq2 : alpha*beta^2*beta = alpha*beta^3 := by ring
    have heq3 : alpha^2*beta*beta = alpha^2*beta^2 := by ring
    rw [heq1] at h1
    rw [heq2] at h2
    rw [heq3] at h3
    linarith only [h1,h2,h3]
  have hquartic : 1/(A^2*B^2*C^2) ≤ 1/(alpha^2*beta^4) := by
    have h : 1/(A^2*B^2*C^2) ≤ 1/(alpha^2*beta^2*beta^2) := by gcongr
    have heq : alpha^2*beta^2*beta^2 = alpha^2*beta^4 := by ring
    simpa only [heq] using h
  have hnormal : tau ≤
      (2*K*(A^2+B^2+C^2+T^2)+L*(A*B+A*C+A*T+B*C+B*T+C*T)+Q)/(A^2*B^2*C^2) := by
    have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hupper (by positivity : 0 ≤ A^2*B^2*C^2)
    convert h using 1
    dsimp [tau]
    field_simp [hAn, hBn, hCn]
    ring
  change tau ≤ _
  calc
    tau ≤ _ := hnormal
    _ = 2*K*tau^2+
        2*K*(1/(B^2*C^2)+1/(A^2*C^2)+1/(A^2*B^2))+
        L*tau*(1/(B*C)+1/(A*C)+1/(A*B))+
        L*(1/(A*B*C^2)+1/(A*B^2*C)+1/(A^2*B*C))+Q*(1/(A^2*B^2*C^2)) := by
      dsimp [tau]
      field_simp [hAn, hBn, hCn]
      ring
    _ ≤ 2*K*tau^2+
        2*K*(1/beta^4+1/(alpha^2*beta^2)+1/(alpha^2*beta^2))+
        L*tau*(1/beta^2+1/(alpha*beta)+1/(alpha*beta))+
        L*(1/(alpha*beta^3)+1/(alpha*beta^3)+1/(alpha^2*beta^2))+Q*(1/(alpha^2*beta^4)) := by
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Convex quadratic endpoint exclusion, proved by its chord identity. -/
theorem frontier_quadratic_interval_exclusion (a b c lo hi x : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hlo : lo < x) (hhi : x ≤ hi)
    (hql : a*lo^2+b*lo+c < 0) (hqh : a*hi^2+b*hi+c < 0)
    (hqx : 0 ≤ a*x^2+b*x+c) : False := by
  have hleft := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hhi) hql.le
  have hright := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr hlo) hqh
  have hwidth : 0 ≤ hi-lo := by linarith only [hlo,hhi]
  have hmid := mul_nonneg hwidth hqx
  have hcorr := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hwidth)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hlo.le)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hhi)
  nlinarith only [hleft,hright,hmid,hcorr]

end D1Bound5

import D1Bound5.PairSelectedFloorWitnesses

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Check at most `n` head rows of the existing selected-mask/floor checker.
Every row is evaluated against its entire actual remaining vertex tail.
The corresponding packed mask word and floor list advance with their head;
unequal remaining list lengths reject as soon as they are encountered. -/
def pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool {tau nu : ℤ} (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    Nat → List (PairResidueVertex tau nu) → List (ℕ × List ℕ) → Bool
  | 0, _, _ => true
  | _ + 1, [], [] => true
  | n + 1, x :: xs, (code, ks) :: rows =>
      pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x xs code ks &&
        pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n xs rows
  | _ + 1, _, _ => false

/-- Literal Boolean factorization of the existing selected-mask/floor checker.
No pair crossing the cut is lost: the earlier head is checked against
the full tail, including every vertex after the cut. Both the vertex and
witness lists are dropped by the same amount. -/
theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_eq_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) :
    pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows =
      (pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows &&
        pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n)) := by
  induction n generalizing cached rows with
  | zero =>
      simp only [pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool, List.drop_zero, Bool.true_and]
  | succ n ih =>
      cases cached with
      | nil => cases rows <;> rfl
      | cons x xs =>
          cases rows with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons item rows =>
              rcases item with ⟨code, ks⟩
              change
                (pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x xs code ks &&
                  pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve xs rows) =
                ((pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x xs code ks &&
                    pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n xs rows) &&
                  pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve (xs.drop n) (rows.drop n))
              rw [ih xs rows, Bool.and_assoc]

/-- Assemble two independently checked pieces into exactly the previous
checker. This can be repeated for arbitrary block widths, including zero
or a width beyond the end; the final remainder must still be certified. -/
theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hprefix : pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows = true :=
  (pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_eq_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows).trans
    (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨hprefix, htail⟩)

/-- A final prefix covering both lists leaves the original empty checker.
Length equality is not assumed: malformed unequal-length lists still fail
inside the checked prefix, including an extra final witness row. -/
theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_cover {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hcached : cached.length ≤ n) (hrows : rows.length ≤ n)
    (hprefix : pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true) :
    pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows = true := by
  apply pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows hprefix
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hcached, List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hrows]
  rfl

/-- Only independence is split. The original exact vertex projection and
the original full signature validation remain separate checked inputs. -/
theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_of_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (hcover : cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices)
    (hvalid : (cached.all fun x =>
      decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) = true)
    (hprefix : pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached rows = true := by
  have hindependent :=
    pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows hprefix htail
  apply Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨hvalid, hindependent⟩⟩
  simp [hcover]

/-- Chunk composition reaches the exact original independent-class Boolean
through the existing selected-floor soundness theorem, preserving the full
meaning of every downstream graph certificate. -/
theorem pairIndependentBool_of_selected_floor_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < QuadInt.discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (hcover : cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices)
    (hvalid : (cached.all fun x =>
      decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) = true)
    (hprefix : pairSelectedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairIndependentBool sieve vertices = true :=
  pairIndependentBool_of_selected_floor_certificate hd sieve vertices cached rows
    (pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_of_prefix_drop sieve vertices cached rows n
      hcover hvalid hprefix htail)

end D1Bound5
